mission.title: litellm: Feature request: support multiple ChatGPT OAuth accounts in a single LiteLLM instance
mission.description: Feature request: support multiple ChatGPT OAuth accounts in a single LiteLLM instance. Requested by 46+ users.

steps.title: Check current litellm deployment
steps.description:
Verify your litellm version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm
helm list -n litellm 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working litellm installation.

steps.title: Review litellm configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant litellm configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm
kubectl get configmap -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=litellm
```
LiteLLM's current ChatGPT OAuth support appears to be effectively single-account per proxy process because the authenticator only reads one global `CHATGPT_TOKEN_DIR` / `CHATGPT_AUTH_FILE` pair.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Feature request: support multiple ChatGPT OAuth accounts in…
steps.description:
Apply the configuration change to resolve the issue:
```yaml
model_list:
  - model_name: chatgpt-account-a
    litellm_params:
      model: chatgpt/gpt-5.4
      chatgpt_auth_file: /tokens/account-a/auth.json

  - model_name: chatgpt-account-b
    litellm_params:
      model: chatgpt/gpt-5.4
      chatgpt_auth_file: /tokens/account-b/auth.json
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm
kubectl get events -n litellm --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Feature request: support multiple ChatGPT OAuth accounts in…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: See the source issue for the community-verified solution: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/23777
